sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 739)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across two hilarious eras of *The Burns and Allen Show* (planning high-society Hollywood parties for Campbell's in 1935 and post-vacation wardrobe dilemmas for Maxwell House in 1947), Commander Buzz Corry locating lost worlds on *Space Patrol* for Ralston Purina, Edward Arnold portraying President Zachary Taylor on *Mr. President*, Martin Blaine breaking jewel fencing cartels on *The FBI in Peace and War*, and peacetime military medical tributes on *The Voice of the Army*, George Burns & Gracie Allen (1935, 1947), Ed Kemmer (1954), Edward Arnold (1949), Martin Blaine (1952), and US Army (1935–1954):
